text:
Maya: Quick sync — Mistral tenant provisioning is stalled. Network reports outbound blocks to our registry and CRL endpoints. Customer asked for a single egress IP instead of wide ranges. Who can own the short-term egress plan (NAT vs proxy)? @Owen @Priya
Owen: I can take the NAT IP path. Has anyone opened the cloud/billing request yet? need the exact hostnames to include in the ticket.
Priya: Network confirms blocked to images.redwood-infra.svc:443 and updater.redwood-infra.svc. Customer is semi-airgapped — they only allow a handful of outbound destinations. I tried `curl -v https://images.redwood-infra.svc` from their jump host, TLS handshake times out.
Sam: Short-term we can do one static NAT IP + a proxy (HTTP CONNECT) for certificate revocation and image pulls. Long-term recommend a pull-through mirror in their registry.
Maya: Customer ops prefers single IP. Owen, can you request a reserved NAT and share the IP here? Also need SAML metadata sync + CRL endpoints (443/80) called out.
Owen: Will request static NAT from cloud team. ETA: 4 hours to get approval if billing ok. Please paste the hostname list so I include it in the ticket.
Priya: Hostlist to whitelist: images.redwood-infra.svc, updater.redwood-infra.svc, kms-proxy.redwood-infra.svc, crl.pki.example.com, time.google.com (NTP). Also note KMS traffic is proxied and needs persistent source IP. I'll add this to the #networking ticket.
Sam: Noted. Also ran into image signature error on their appliance: `signature verification: missing key id 0xAB12`. Might be a GPG key sync issue on their airgap device.
Maya: Likely their GPG keyset didn't sync. Priya — can you confirm the signing key fingerprint so support can push it via offline method?
Priya: Fingerprint: AB12 34CD 56EF 7890 1234 5678 9ABC DEF0 AB12 34CD. I'll attach to the ticket and include offline instructions for customer ops to import.
InfraBot: DeployBot: canary deploy for mistral-tenant started at 2026-03-18T09:12Z — paused due to registry fetch error.
Owen: Filed cloud request #CL-4579 for static NAT and attached host list. Cloud says possible but needs billing approval; I've flagged it as urgent and pushed for an answer by 12:00 PDT.
Sam: I'll draft a fallback runbook: steps to use customer S3 mirror + offline image import if NAT isn't approved. Creating doc and will link it here.
Priya: Ticket updated, customer confirmed they can accept a single IP (they just need it capped to one). I've also sent the GPG fingerprint to support.
Sam: Fallback doc draft up: https://confluence.internal/redwood/mistral-fallback — includes smoke test commands and verification steps. Will run a staging smoke once NAT IP is available.
Maya: Action items recap: Owen -> secure static NAT + post IP here; Priya -> update networking ticket with hosts + fingerprint; Sam -> fallback runbook + staging smoke. We'll leave thread open and re-check when NAT IP is assigned. If NAT blocked, escalate to EngOps. :white_check_mark:
InfraBot: IncidentBot: status updated -> monitoring. Assigned: CloudTeam, NetworkTeam.
